course_summary:
ISEN 622 | Linear Programming | Fall 2026
Instructor: Sergiy Butenko | butenko@tamu.edu
Meets: T, R | Online
Grading: Lecture quizzes [10%], Homework assignments [15%], Three in-class exams [25% each] — A: [90,100], B: [80,90), C: [70,80), D: [60,70), F: [0,60)
Topics: Gomory Cut, Farkas' Lemma, KKT Conditions, The Primal-Dual Simplex Method, Dantzig-Wolfe Decomposition, Two-Stage Stochastic LP, Modeling Either/Or Conditions, Complementary slackness, Simplex Method in the Matrix Form, Parametric Linear Programming, revised simplex, dual simplex methods, bounded variables, column generation, decomposition, integer programming, convex sets, cones, polyhedral sets, duality theory, sensitivity analysis, simplex, Graphical Method, LP Modeling, linear optimization models, small-scale LPs, large-scale LPs, linear programming (LP) theory, algorithms, mathematics, Iteration, Termination, Initialization, Analysis of the Simplex Method, Properties of Polyhedra, Representation of Polyhedra, LP Duality
Tools: Optimization
